proposals.title: Refill reminders
proposals.why: 308 customers are due to reorder a product they buy again and again, and 147 more come due within 30 days; 25% of people like them reordered within a month.

basis.label: People we never contact
basis.value: 10% are left out of the money: they are what proves the effect
basis.source: the default share of people we never contact (autonomy/contracts Envelope)

basis.label: Your buying rate
basis.value: 25% (21% to 29%) of 449 people like them bought within 30 days (3 look-backs)

basis.label: Refill boost
basis.value: x1.49 on the message's lift while the refill window is open

basis.label: What one message adds
basis.value: +0.67 points (0.34 to 1.00) to the chance of a purchase
basis.source: One e-mail added 0.45 points (0.23 to 0.67) to the chance of a purchase within 14 days, against sending nothing, in the randomised Hillstrom e-mail test (library/hillstrom-email/run_report.md)

basis.label: Message cost
basis.value: 2 messages each at about 0.001 USD

audience.description: Due to reorder a product they buy again and again

proposals.goal_text: Refill reminders for 409 customers in the next 30 days: about $60 extra profit a month ($29 to $94)
